page_title: CRY 0-0 FUL | Crystal Palace v Fulham 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The game is interrupted as Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) is flagged offside.
90+1' It will be a substitution. Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) is ready to enter the pitch as Odsonne Edouard walks off.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Paul Tierney signals a set piece.
88' The resulting corner from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

88' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

86' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
83' Willian (Fulham) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Sam Johnstone makes a great save.
80' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Raul Jimenez and he is replaced by Carlos Vinicius (Fulham).
79' Substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid leaves the pitch and is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
78' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
78' Issa Diop (Fulham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
75' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) replaces Andreas Pereira.
75' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Paul Tierney interrupts the game.
73' A cross into the box from Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
70' That will be all from Jeffrey Schlupp who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
69' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) as his effort only hit the wall.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' A pass by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' The current number of shots on goal is 2:4.
61' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
59' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
54' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
52' A player from Crystal Palace brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
50' The Crystal Palace players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
48' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Paul Tierney blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
44' The total number of attempts is 3:4.
43' The opposition back off Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky!
40' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
37' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Paul Tierney who sees an offensive foul.
36' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.

36' A nice lofted cross finds Raul Jimenez (Fulham) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
32' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno is alert and thwarts the effort.
31' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 0:1.
27' Some patient build-up play from Fulham as they look to unlock the defence.
25' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle.
22' The game is interrupted now, Joao Palhinha (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
20' Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul after Tim Ream (Fulham) hacks down one of his opponents.
19' The possession of the ball – 53:47.
16' Yellow card. Tim Ream (Fulham) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
14' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
12' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
11' Willian (Fulham) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the bottom right corner, but Sam Johnstone shows his agility and makes a save.
10' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
9' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Joao Palhinha (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Crystal Palace are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
5' Dangerous play by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Great touch by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
